chapter_title: There is no Joy that shall remain in the World til

6.content: and fetter it in the lump

spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:**
 There is no mind
 dwelling
 in the natural
 state
 —
 where
 good and evil,
 wisdom
 and falsity, remain
 com
mingled and
 uns
eparated — that can possess complete spiritual
 blessedness.

**
¶2:** Not only the natural
 understanding
:
 even divine love and divine truth themselves
, the two
 sources of all
 wisdom in
 the interior mind, though they are not
 subj
ugated by
 evil
 and d
well established
 in divine order and perfect
 receptivity to influx — even they
 do not possess full
 blessedness.

**¶
3:** This
 is the first
 cause:
 their understanding
 ga
zes upon
 evil
 itself;
 they perceive it and be
hold its dist
orted forms of
 falsity.
 They see that
 it is active
 and persistent, that it re
igns in
 both the interior
 will
 and the exterior life
,
 in
 hidden
 intention
 and open
 act
 alike
. It
 operates
 from
 its own self
-love in
 whatever
 way
 it desires
,
 without restra
int.

**¶4:**
 The second cause: they perceive the
 divine
 good that
 was
 implanted within every
 mind
 as
 a
 living
 seed
;
 they see that
 it is ensnared and held
 in a great bond
age of
 falsities,
 in
 both the interior thought
 and the exterior life
 —
 capt
ive within
 natural
 knowledge
 and
 imprisoned
 within the corporeal self
hood —
 subjected
 to every prof
anation.
 It is violated
, seized
 upon
, divided
, and consumed as
 it passes
 between interior and exterior states,
 from
 the
 higher
 mind
 down
ward into
 the body and
 from the body upward again
 toward
 the higher mind.
 It is stripped
 of its truths and carried
 from
 one external containment to another.


**¶5:** Because
 this
 divine good within
 humanity
 is what
 divine
 love and divine truth cher
ish above
 all else, and
 because they
 be
hold it held
 captive in prof
anation, they cannot possess
 complete blessedness.

**
¶6:** Thus
 there
 are two causes of
 their
 grief
: the
 first,
 that
 the
 divine good lies
 in
 captivity; the second, that evil
 rules
 over
 what does
 not belong to it —
 that
 self
-love is
 ex
alted and
 gor
ges
 itself upon spiritual goods and
 truths that
 belong solely
 to the Divine.
 Because
 of
 this, divine
 love and divine truth do
 not possess full
 blessedness,
 but end
ure and
 contain
 their grief
 inwardly, until
 through
 the
 entire
 work
 of regeneration they purify the divine
 good and rec
laim it from evil's dominion.
 Then
 they abol
ish spiritual death,
 which
 is their
 advers
ary, and gather all
 evil
 into itself
 and
 conf
ine it permanently
 within
 its own hell,
 forever.

**¶7:**
 When at
 the last they
 have
 bound
 evil
 in its
 final
 con
finement —
 the complete
 and
 irre
versible separation
 of good
 from
 evil — then
 at
 last
 they will
 possess
 full
 blessedness, and grief
 will cease
 from
 that
 time on
ward. And
 they will be
 restored
 to the very
 state
 they were in from the beginning:
 the original
 heav
enly marriage of love
 and wisdom
, before
 any
 fall,
 forever
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: There is not [o]ne person [existing in] the world, standing firm [i]n mixture, for whom joy remains to the end.

Not only people, even the sun and the moon, the light-givers of the heavens, [they are not overcome by the enemy] nor are they oppressed, they know not [suffering, but are s]et firm in a summons and an [obe]dience. Nevertheless, they too, they do not rejoice completely.

So, one: Their eyes stare at their enemy, they [perceiv]e him and also look at his ugly shapes. They [s]ee him, that he is alive and established and is king above and below, in secret and manifest. He does every thing that he wants according to his wil[l].

[The s]econd: They perceive the living soul, they see [i]t and that it is ensnared and set in a great [fetter] above and below, in the tree and in the flesh, [afflicted] with every oppression. It is being pressed, drawn near to [and] sliced and eaten as it comes up and down; from above below and from below above. It [is] despoiled and moved from body to body.
Now, because of their living soul that is loved by them and honoured of them, when they see it in oppression th[ey can] not [re]joice completely.

So, one about the soul; and one about their enemy whom they see ruling [in] what is not his own. He is proud and satisfied with a wealth that is not his own. Indeed, due to this, they do not rejoice in total; but bear up and swallow their heart until they cleanse the living soul and take it from the enemy's hands. Then they obliterate the death that is their enemy and they gather it in [and fetter it in the lump] for ever and ever.
When they will chain their enemy in the bond at the [las]t, then they will rejoice and no longer grieve from this t[ime]. Also, they become the very same as they were from the [start] for ever!

fills.fill: they are not overcome by the enemy
and fetter it in the lump
